title: Japanese Onion Hash
description: A crispy Japanese-style onion hash made with roasted onions, perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: Peel the roasted onion and slice it into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Cut the german onion into 1/2-inch pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced roasted onion and chopped german onion.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until the onions are caramelized.
While the onions are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the hash to the pan and cook until crispy and golden brown.
Fluff the hash with a fork and set aside.
Once the onions are done roasting, remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the crispy hash.
Serve the Japanese onion hash hot, garnished with additional hash if desired.
